cover_subtitle: A 20m² composite deck in Evalast Infinity — built by Endure.

your_project.summary_line: A 20m² composite deck in Evalast Infinity — built by Endure. Total area 20m². 2.5 build days.
your_project.description: Merbau deck across both areas. H4 bearers, H3 joists, concrete footings, oil finish. 8 build days bundled — efficient overheads, single project window.
bullets: Evalast Infinity 140mm composite decking — premium hardwood, both areas
H4 bearers (90×90) — heavier subframe for longer service
H3 joists (90×45) — properly sized and spaced
Concrete footings — 20kg premix, 2 bags per hole
Deck plans — drawn and shared before we start
your_project.footnote: Single build window keeps the job clean and efficient.

cost_lines.label: Project Requirements
cost_lines.desc: Project Management · Working Drawings · Site Prep · Site Cleaning

cost_lines.label: Supply & Install — Composite Deck (20m²)
cost_lines.desc: H4 bearers · H3 joists · Concrete footings · Evalast Infinity 140mm composite decking · Oil finish · Front + Rear areas

fixed.included: All timber complies with engineering. H4 bearers, H3 joists, concrete footings. Evalast Infinity 140mm composite decking with hidden fixings. Project management, working drawings, site prep + site cleaning.
fixed.excluded: Painting or staining. Local council approval (if required, separate quote). Electrical work (lighting, fans, power). Railings or stairs (if needed, separate quote).

project_run.lead: From acceptance to handover. Payment is split into five claims tied to real milestones.

steps.title: Acceptance
steps.body: Verbal acceptance and 5% deposit confirms your project and locks the build window.

steps.title: Pre-start meeting
steps.body: Around 3 weeks before build, your Project Manager runs through site and build specifics with you on site. Triggers the 25% pre-start claim.

steps.title: Materials ordered
steps.body: Once the pre-start meeting is signed off, we order materials.

steps.title: Materials delivered
steps.body: Materials land on site. Triggers the 25% materials claim.

steps.title: Build starts
steps.body: Build commences. Daily updates from site through to handover.

steps.title: Subframe complete
steps.body: Posts, bearers, joists installed and tape-protected. Triggers the 25% structural claim.

steps.title: Handover
steps.body: Walk-through, care guide, warranty handover. Final 20% balance due on handover.
